prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on several winning home wait_info and adoption redesign tests.
Adding new screens at adoption or finish stages consistently hurt performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful.
Updating home wait_info frequently generated wins (5 wins), though many tests showed no clear effect.
Finish copy changes (4 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or mixed for change types with only one test or conflicting outcomes.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Dynamic Render Milestone Indicator: Display a dynamic progress bar and estimated timer component on the generation waiting screen while rendering pet assets. (why: The home waiting stage has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; updating wait info has yielded 5 prior wins by reducing perceived wait frustration.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Adoption-First Sign-In Sequence Shift: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 25% of users early; letting users select their companion first builds emotional investment prior to account creation.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Background Notification Alert: Enable desktop notifications when rendering completes and display copy reassuring users they can minimize the app. (why: Mean time on the waiting stage is over 38 minutes; users leave the window open without knowing they can safely minimize it.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Preservation Sign-In Clarification: Update sign-in headline and hint to clarify that logging into an existing account restores saved pets and prevents reset issues. (why: Support received 8 emails about missing or reset pets after signing back in with different credentials.)
4: [finish, layout] Split Desktop Controls Overview: Switch home_intro to a split layout showcasing quick desktop pet interaction controls and tray visibility tips. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing/opening and 3 about confusion over how to control or hide the pet after onboarding.)

scores.note: Home step loses only 5.7% of users, but wait info updates have a strong track record of 5 historical wins (+1.3% mean lift).
Sign-in drops 25% of users, but structural reordering requires significant release effort and reorder tests show modest historical lift (+0.4%).
Addressing the 38-minute mean wait time is backed by funnel data, but notification changes historically show mixed to negative results.
Strong evidence from 25% sign-in drop and 8 support emails, but copy changes consistently fail to generate positive lift.
Finish loses 29.1% and support emails confirm user confusion, but past finish layout changes consistently showed no clear effect.
